findings.summary: L3 validity binding is not fail-closed and does not guarantee a complete validity key. PluginMaterializer._validity_key catches DispatchError and git errors and returns None, allowing a stage to seal without the required binding. GraphGateNode._validity_binding catches all exceptions and records an unavailable marker instead of refusing the gate. In addition, the production callers bind only the committed SPEC digest and, at most, target identity; acceptance-context revision and PR identity remain empty. Therefore product revision/tree, SPEC, acceptance context, target, and PR are not jointly sealed and verified across the lifecycle as required.
